task_suite.system_message: Answer with only the requested value. No explanation or additional words.
task_suite.test_suite_origin: SSI_MULTIQ_BASELINE_BRIDGE_B1.py; generated tasks only, not publishing private implementation
limitations: Public development set; not a hidden benchmark
SCC-like strings are synthetic and do not test native parser
Short tasks do not represent long-context/multi-step real missions

arms.machine: CORE24 CPU; cgroup memory limit explicitly recorded

arms.backend: same model and hardware as IQ2_CPU_PLAIN
arms.requirement: Evidence of an actually executed MultiQuant optimization path before claiming a model speed or memory benefit

arms.backend: same executable/runtime as enabled mode with flags disabled

shared_run_settings.input_messages: Read exact messages array from frozen suite. No prompt rewording, added examples, RAG tools or implicit system variations.
shared_run_settings.chat_template: Pinned Llama 3.1 instruct chat-template; log rendered prompt hash per task and tokenizer input token IDs hash on each engine.
shared_run_settings.tokenizer_revision: Match BF16 and GGUF lineage; if hashes or token IDs differ, mark PROMPT_PARITY_FAIL and do not claim paired quality equivalence.
shared_run_settings.eos_behavior: Document EOS/EOT/pad IDs and any engine-specific stop sequences; verify comparable early stopping.
shared_run_settings.context_window: Record exact backend context-window setting and admitted prompt tokens.
shared_run_settings.time_metrics: Always split cold startup/download/load from warm prompt prefill/decoding. Same hardware arms must be evaluated in matched cache regimes.
shared_run_settings.trial_plan: Smoke pilot of M01/W03/E01/G04/S03; after approved budget, 32 cases x 3 sequential runs per available arm; record all failures and incomplete runs.
shared_run_settings.order_rule: Use precommitted case permutation and apply identical ordering; balance cold/warm state for same-hardware ablations.
shared_run_settings.gpu_paid_run_gate: Operator approval required for exact spend cap and actual GPU/storage per-hour rates before starting any paid Pod.
shared_run_settings.runtime_integrity_gate: Record model IDs/revisions, quantization file hash and inference engine commit; if model lineage cannot be established, report as mismatch without attribution.

normalization: Collapse repeated internal whitespace to one ASCII space
Keep digits/signs/punctuation unchanged; no numeric tolerance (4.0 does not equal 4)
scoring.denominator: All 32 cases when full arm completed; missing/failed answers are not silently excluded; report incomplete campaigns separately.
scoring.minimum_quality_reporting: per case raw/normalized answers in private evidence, exact-match score per category and total, failure counts, paired error analysis
scoring.limitations: 32 short public tasks too small to establish production usefulness or robust model superiority; larger blind held-out tasks required.

cost_rules.GPU: actual provider compute rate x billed seconds / 3600 + actual storage/egress; include all billed warmup/load/idle/setup time; quote marginal warm-only cost separately
cost_rules.CPU: declare reserved VPS flat-rate allocation OR incremental metered rate; never treat sunk fixed VPS price as universally zero; include storage and resource allocation assumptions
cost_rules.per_completed_task: total run cost / all finished tasks, with failure counts disclosed
cost_rules.per_correct_answer: total campaign cost / number of correct answered tasks; null when zero correct
cost_rules.energy: kWh estimates only if real GPU power and CPU/mains telemetry available; no invented energy or carbon figure
cost_rules.hardware_comparability: Cross hardware BF16 GPU vs IQ2 CPU gives observed end-to-end time/cost and quality; cannot attribute time difference to MultiQuant.
cost_rules.module_attribution: Only CPU IQ2 vs CPU IQ2 with actual MultiQuant modules on the same host, model, context, cgroup and matched cache may attribute a measured change to modules; document any remaining confounders.

claims_gates.public_ready: Suite frozen, operator records both arms, prompt/tokenizer parity, complete denominators, independent reruns, and cost provenance verified
claims_gates.performance_advantage: Same hardware/model controlled ablation plus time/load/quality measurements and explicit uncertainty; no conclusion from cross-hardware numbers
